versions.notes: Print the receipt after payment, or start a new sale. Scan a barcode to add that product to the sale.
The keypad stays above Cash and Card on a small window, and the receipt is shown after payment.
The sign-in screen scrolls while the on-screen keyboard is open, so the fields stay visible.

Demo sign-in uses the username demo-shop and the Admin button. The payment reminder appears only on a paid subscription with two days left. Categories and products scroll, and the till fits the window.
Demo sign-in on the login screen, sample products, a contact line, a Z report that clears the shift, and a payment reminder when two days remain.
Type a price on the keypad, then tap a category and a product. The product is sold at that price.
Check for updates from Settings. Day end, a separate till for each shop, and manual items.
First public installer. Each shop has its own blank till, and the admin can reset a forgotten cashier PIN.
